fire: Thank you for the quick reply! Our manager gave me access.

Dear Mr. Rossi,
In regards to your recent test, I have some questions.
Wonderful photos, Anna! I love the first one of you.
Thanks so much for writing! My sister loved it.

Hello Dr. Lee,
With regard to the last report, I have a concern.
Great post, Sam! I tried this at home.
Thank you for the advice! Our cat is much better.

Dear Editor,
Concerning your article, I have a comment.
quiet: The quick train left early. Our manager was on it.
Mr. Rossi lives in a town near the recent test site.
Photos of Anna hang in the first room of the house.
So much writing made my sister tired.
Dr. Lee went home after the last report was done.
The post office is closed at home time.
The advice is printed on the back of the bag.
The editor wrote the article and sent it out.
